input.prompt:
One continuous ten-second locked-off tripod shot at the existing workshop table. The camera does not move at all: no pan, tilt, zoom, drift, follow or reframing, and no cuts. Preserve the supplied starting frame's exact owner and buyer, faces, hair, glasses, tan work shirt, steel-blue overshirt, diffuse daylight, room, table, green binder, sheet, pencil and keys. Owner seated screen left, buyer seated screen right.

For the first four seconds both stay seated as in the frame, looking at the sheet, with only breathing and a blink. At about four seconds the buyer sits back and slowly pushes his chair out from the table with both hands on the table edge; the chair legs visibly slide back. He stands up slowly, without hurry. He turns toward screen right and walks off screen right at a slow, heavy pace, shaking his head slowly from side to side as he goes. He is out of frame by about eight and a half seconds. The owner stays seated, hands near the sheet, and her eyes follow him. Hold on the owner and the empty pushed-out chair to the end.

He takes nothing from the table and does not look back. No speaking, no lip movement, no handshake, no pointing, no angry gesture, no slammed chair, no pause with his hand on the chair. The sheet stays unreadable. No new person, prop, text or sound. Real-time motion; no slow motion effect.

selected_slot.selection: One continuous window: seated through 'cannot inspect', chair push on 'So he does one of two things' (~339.12), walk-off with head shake through 'or he walks', owner hold to 343.125. Choose source offset after playback; no speed change.
